analyst_view.overall: Freiburg played Thursday night and beat Trabzonspor 1-0 in the Conference League, so Julian Schuster may rotate, with Scherhant, Treu, Beste and Suzuki possible starters. Union Berlin, now coached by Mauro Lustrinelli, have scored only three goals in their last five games and one German report calls them relegation-threatened. Midfielder Aljoscha Kemlein is out with a shoulder injury (he is not on the site's list), while striker Andrej Ilic could return from a long layoff after a single week of training.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.9 goals. Union have barely scored lately (three in five, and only two real chances in the 1-1 with Köln), and Lustrinelli has warned not to expect much from Ilic after a week of training. Freiburg won 1-0 on Thursday with Schuster himself saying they were not clinical enough, and some rotation is likely. Freiburg winning comfortably is possible, but the total looks more likely to fall short of 2.9.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.9 corners. Freiburg should have most of the ball against a low-scoring Union, and Grifo's set pieces gave them their winner on Thursday. Tired legs after the European trip work the other way, so nothing pulls clearly from the site's figure.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.5 cards. Union are fighting near the bottom and are without the suspended Felix Uduokhai, so a scrappy, defensive away display is likely. We found nothing specific about Sascha Stegemann this season, so we stay close to the site's number.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.2 shots. Union's attack has been very blunt, creating just two real chances last weekend, and Kemlein's absence takes energy out of midfield. With Freiburg possibly rotating three days after a European away game, the shot total could come in a little lower.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.4 shots on target. Union's lack of chances and Ilic being far from match-fit point to a low away share, and Freiburg were wasteful on Thursday. A slightly lower figure looks more likely.
